in_marathi.name: Nimrata
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Death
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimrata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nimrata is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Goddess of Death'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Yama, the god of death. Nimrata is believed to be a powerful and fearsome deity, who is often invoked during rituals and ceremonies to ensure a peaceful transition of the soul from this world to the next.
